name: bouclier-compat-lint
description: Checks that the extension's JavaScript and CSS only use features Safari 16.4 (iOS 16.4, macOS) supports. Run: npm install && npm run lint

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.lint:js: cd ../.. && BROWSERSLIST='safari >= 16.4, ios_saf >= 16.4' tests/compat/node_modules/.bin/eslint -c tests/compat/eslint.config.mjs extension appstore/app
